title: Booking calendar
summary: Bookable time slots with capacity, a day picker, my bookings with cancel, and rules that stop double-booking.
description: Adds time slots attached to whatever people book (a room, a coach, a class type, a court) and reservations against them. People pick a day, see places left and book; they can cancel their own upcoming bookings. Staff manage times on a week calendar and book people in by hand. Rules refuse a full slot, a slot that has started, two overlapping bookings for the same person, and two overlapping slots for the same resource.

params.name: attach_to
params.label: What is booked
params.description: The table of things people book time with (rooms, coaches, courts, services).

params.name: booker_role
params.label: Who books
params.description: The role whose people make bookings (their own table is the booker).

params.name: org_field
params.label: Organisation (optional)
params.description: Optional: the ref on that table naming its organisation (from organisations-and-teams). Time slots then belong to that organisation and only its members see and book them.

notes: A table of things to book and a role with its own table for the people booking.

includes: SlotPicker and MyReservations components with their pages
Staff week calendar and reservations list
Workflows that keep places left up to date
highlights: Rule: no double-booking, for people and for resources
Rule: no booking a full or started slot
Cancel is a request the server applies: nobody edits a booking by hand
